title: Phande Baaz
desc: A clever man uses wit and disguise to outsmart villains and protect his loved ones.

title: Santosh
desc: A wealthy woman falls in love with a poor man, whom she marries and has a child with, but soon she longs for her old life and abandons both her husband and son. She remarries a rich man, with whom she has another son. Years later, the two boys find themselves on opposite sides of a struggle.

title: Aadmi Aur Insaan
desc: Jai and Munish's friendship is ruined when both of them fall in love with the same girl, Meena. Things take a turn when Munish finds out Jai was involved in the case of a faulty railway bridge.

title: Yaraana
desc: JB, a borderline psychopath, is attracted to Lalita, a beautiful, young woman. He forces her to marry him but she runs away on her wedding day by feigning unconsciousness.

title: Apna Bana Lo
desc: A widowed mother loses her child near a well during a journey on foot. Follows her emotional path through grief and acceptance as she navigates life after the devastating loss.
